scenes.text: A stick is 6 centimetres long. It is turned by 15 degrees. How long is it now? Let us think carefully. Turning changes its direction, not its length. The answer is 6. Great work!
Two 7-centimetre sticks point in different directions. How much longer is one than the other? Let us think carefully. Equal-length sticks have a difference of zero. The answer is 0. Great work!
You rotate a 8-centimetre paper strip so it points upwards. What length will a ruler show? Let us think carefully. A strip keeps its length after being rotated. The answer is 8. Great work!
A stick is 9 centimetres long. It is turned by 60 degrees. How long is it now? Let us think carefully. Turning changes its direction, not its length. The answer is 9. Great work!
